name: sol-advisor
description: Lightweight native collaboration with scouts, workers, optional reviewers and explicit task ownership.

interface.shortDescription: Focused agents with direct collaboration and clear ownership.
interface.longDescription: Split substantial work among model-named scouts, workers and optional reviewers. Scout uses Luna high; Worker uses Sol medium or high. Share dependent evidence directly, preserve user changes and active authorization, and integrate ordinary results without duplicate work or fixed pipelines.
defaultPrompt: Split useful work among focused scouts and workers; keep small tasks local.
Let teammates share dependent evidence directly while preserving task ownership and authorization.
Integrate actual changes and check evidence; use independent review only when it improves the outcome.
